compiler_policy: The current full-Rust route is the pinned Lustr coordinator with rustc-derived BlueFe. Direct native Lust coverage requires its own exact compiler identity and behavior receipts. Application CI consumes qualified compiler artifacts.
layout_policy: Retain upstream paths. Current crates are preserved during recovery; domain_owner records where their responsibilities belong. Move source separately from behavior changes.
intentional_divergences: redb remains the persistence destination; SQLite stays authoritative until the complete transaction boundary is qualified.

The selected production server and CLI use the complete omdb application boundary through one transaction owner. Native schema80 to88 upgrade preserves activated data and updates citation-aware message search, turn item counts and custom project titles. Typed native APIs cover atomic event guards, outbox claims, compaction filters, fork visibility, shell and recovery state, attachment retention, scheduler compare-and-set KeepAwake active-run existence and legacy subagent identifier retention. The active-run query stops at the first indexed match. Bootstrap and CLI preserve upgrade ownership and never reopen SQLite after native activation. SQLite remains the migration source, immutable behavior comparison and unqualified-platform implementation. Fresh exact-commit platform receipts remain required.
